title: Turn Any Folder Into a Local Website
description: Use Python's built-in HTTP server to preview or share a folder on a trusted local network.
hook: This folder can become a local website with one command.

scenes.headline: A WEBSITE. ONE COMMAND.
scenes.narration: This folder can become a local website with one command. No upload. No account. No dashboard with fourteen tabs.
scenes.caption: Serve a folder locally.

scenes.headline: SKIP THE UPLOAD LOOP
scenes.narration: Open a terminal inside the folder you want to share. Python already includes the small server we need.
scenes.caption: Use the folder you intend to share.

scenes.headline: LOCALHOST:8000
scenes.narration: Run the command on screen. Then open localhost colon eight thousand in your browser. Your files appear as a simple local site.
scenes.caption: localhost:8000

scenes.headline: KEEP IT TRUSTED
scenes.narration: Use this on a trusted network, and only serve files you mean to expose. It is a convenience tool, not a security strategy.
scenes.caption: Trusted network. Intended files only.

scenes.headline: DONE? PRESS CONTROL C.
scenes.narration: Press Control C when you are done. A useful server that also understands when to leave. Rare software manners.
scenes.caption: Start fast. Stop cleanly.
